articles.title: ICE deports Venezuelan father from Texas to West Africa: A situation "I don't wish on anybody" - CBS News
articles.description: Carlos Tellez Sanchez had worked at a car dealership in Dallas during the day and drove for Uber Eats at night to support his family.
